title: GS Fighter III
tagline: Fourteen fighters in full 3D. Aura mode, cinematic victories and a full Player Menu.
description: GS Fighter III in the browser: Akeem, Nika and twelve newcomers on the painted Diamond Crest fighter select, each with their own V-Wave color, and Cyborg fires the fast Arc Lance. New in 1.3: painted ROUND, FIGHT! and arcade timer art, a corrected daylight arena (no more washed-out floor), and the Player Menu pauses the match with fighter info, a Move Guide that plays each move's real animation beside its inputs, and full Options for controls, gameplay, audio and video. Training mode gives you a passive dummy and an endless clock. Arcade is best of three against the CPU: Normal by default, up to Ferocious, and your choice sticks. New in 1.4: Aura mode (when you're down to your last 10%, tap AURA READY or press Mid and High punch together for 9 seconds of slowed-down opponent, tougher skin and a flame shield), a letterboxed victory cinematic that glides past the fallen fighter and up to the winner, and quicker recovery after landings and get-ups. Every fighter moves at a brisk 2x, and controller and keyboard can be remapped in Options. Touch, keyboard or controller with rumble; on fighter select the left stick picks you and the right stick picks the CPU.
